name: ha-powerpetdoor-frontend
description: Browser-side tests for the Power Pet Door Lovelace card
comment: The card under test is NOT a Node module. www/powerpetdoor-schedule-card.js
is a plain browser script that defines two custom elements and calls
customElements.define at the bottom. There is no bundler, no import/export,
and no transpile step - what is checked in is byte-for-byte what the browser
loads. So this package exists only to hold the test toolchain; it never
It lives at the repo ROOT rather than beside the tests because ESLint 9's
flat config ignores any file outside its config's base path, and Node
resolves plugins upward from the config file. With both under
tests/frontend/, eslint linted zero files and still exited 0.
No `version` field on purpose. This package is private and never
published, so a version here would be a THIRD number that matches
nothing: the integration is versioned in manifest.json (0.5.0) and the
card carries its own in its header and console banner (1.8.0, enforced
by scripts/check_card_version.py). It previously read 1.0.0, inherited
from the template this was copied from, which was simply confusing.
